risk_note: RV2 settlement (B2-04la; BR-FUND-01 R3 / R3b; D10-169 K-1). Settlement implements orders' onClaimApproved / onAdminAssigned through createAttributionRebatePort: it takes the order_key advisory lock, CASes on the pre-write snapshot, and writes only locked and rebate_status through the generated transition() (R3: UNATTRIBUTED → ESTIMATED / WAITING; R3b: VOID unchanged); it writes no user_id / user_basis / rebate history (orders writes the history after the port) and no funds; out-of-table moves and failed guards throw IllegalTransition, write nothing and log an alert warn; time from input.now. Production mounting stays with orders' claim mounting task (J-1).
